description_en: Queries the detailed information about a health check instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeHealthCheckAttribute查询健康检查实例详情
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-health-check-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --hc-instance-id hc-1k4ucuq77b56x40000 --smart-ag-id sag-1um5x5nwhilymw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHealthCheckAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the health check instance
parameters.name: hc_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the health check instance was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh:
健康检查实例创建时间戳。
单位：毫秒

Description.description_en: The description of the health check instance

DstIpAddr.description_en: The destination IP address of the health check

DstPort.description_en:
The destination port of the health check instance.

This feature is not supported
DstPort.description_zh:
健康检查的目的端口。

该功能目前不支持

FailCountThreshold.description_en:
The maximum number of failed probes before the health check is declared failed.

Valid values: 1 to 15.

Default value: 3
FailCountThreshold.description_zh:
连续探测失败次数阈值。

取值范围：1~15。

默认值：3

HcInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the health check instance

Name.description_en: The name of the health check instance

ProbeCount.description_en:
The number of probes performed per health check.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 1
ProbeCount.description_zh:
每次健康检查探测次数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：1

ProbeInterval.description_en:
The time interval at which probes are performed. The next probe does not start before the current one is complete.

Valid values: 1000 to 60000.

Default value: 2000.

Unit: milliseconds
ProbeInterval.description_zh:
健康检查配置探测间隔，一次探测未完成情况下，不会发起下一次探测。

取值范围：1000~60000。

默认值：2000。

单位：毫秒

ProbeTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period of the probe.

Valid values: 10 to 30000.

Default value: 1000.

Unit: milliseconds
ProbeTimeout.description_zh:
健康检查一次探测的超时时间。

取值范围：10~30000。

默认值：1000。

单位：毫秒

RttFailThreshold.description_en:
The number of times that the maximum RTT is exceeded before an alert is triggered.

Valid values: 1 to 15.

Default value: 3
RttFailThreshold.description_zh:
时延阈值触发次数。

取值范围：1~15。

默认值：3

RttThreshold.description_en:
The maximum round-trip time (RTT).

Value values: -1 and 1 to 5000.

Default value: -1. This value indicates that the RTT threshold is not specified
RttThreshold.description_zh:
双向时延阈值。

取值：-1或1~5000。

默认值：-1，表示不配置双向时延阈值

SmartAGId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

SrcIpAddr.description_en: The source IP address of the health check

SrcPort.description_en:
The source port of the health check instance.

This feature is not supported
SrcPort.description_zh:
健康检查的源端口。

该功能目前不支持

Type.description_en:
The type of packets used in the health check.

Only ICMP_ECHO is supported
Type.description_zh:
健康检查报文类型。

目前仅支持ICMP_ECHO
